chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, raising it, from Hariz, from Yaqoub al-Qummi, from Abu Abd al-A'la, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The price of Paradise is: 'There is no god except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest'.

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of eternal bliss
key_terms.ثَمَنُ: Price, cost, or means of acquisition
key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: There is no god except Allah (the declaration of monotheism)
key_terms.وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ: And Allah is the Greatest (declaration of divine greatness)

ai.seo_question: What is the price of Paradise according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies the recitation of 'La ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu Akbar' as the spiritual currency for entering Paradise. This elevates the dhikr from mere remembrance to a definitive soteriological act, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the transformative power of divine declaration in securing salvation.
